findings.claim: JPM FY2025 10-K 風險因素：營運依賴第三方系統，含提供安全、技術、資料與雲端運算的供應商；內外部營運系統失效可能對公司與客戶造成不利影響。
findings.source: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Form 10-K FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
findings.excerpt: JPMorganChase also depends on its ability to access and use the operational systems of third parties, including vendors that provide security, technology, data and cloud computing services. The inaccessibility, failure or other disruption of an internal or external operational system upon which JPMorganChase's businesses depend could adversely affect JPMorganChase and its clients.

findings.claim: JPM CISO Patrick Opet 2025 年 4 月公開信批評 SaaS 模式的集中風險，指出可能有系統性後果。
findings.source: Plenitude Consulting, 'JP Morgan warns suppliers of SaaS risks in open letter'
findings.excerpt: IT security issues and concentration risk can have systemic consequences, Chief Information Security Officer Patrick Opet has warned.

findings.claim: Dimon 2026 年股東信將烏克蘭與伊朗戰爭、中東衝突及對中國緊張列為主要關切，稱公司不能免於其影響。
findings.source: Yahoo Finance, Jamie Dimon's JPMorgan shareholder letter warns of 2026 risks

findings.claim: Dimon 2023 年表示若美國政府下令，JPM 會退出中國；並稱台灣戰事將使一切押注失效。中國業務含投資與企業銀行、支付、資產管理。
findings.source: CNBC, Jamie Dimon says JPMorgan Chase would exit China if ordered to
